title: FixProposal
description: A PROPOSED remediation for a confirmed hypothesis. Read-only output — this proposal must NOT be automatically applied.

proposal_id.description: Unique fix proposal identifier, e.g. FIX-001.

hypothesis_id.description: The hypothesis ID this fix addresses.

incident_id.description: The incident this proposal belongs to.

status.description: Proposal status before human review. Must remain PROPOSED until the approval gate acts on it.

enum: AWAITING HUMAN APPROVAL — this fix has not been applied.
human_approval_notice.description: Mandatory safety gate disclaimer. Must appear verbatim.

summary.description: One-sentence description of the proposed change.

rationale.description: Explanation of why this change addresses the confirmed root cause.

file.description: Relative path to the file that would be changed.

start_line.description: Start line of the change (1-indexed), or null if not determinable.

end_line.description: End line of the change (1-indexed), or null if not determinable.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this change does.

before.description: The original code snippet that would be replaced.

changes.description: List of individual file changes that make up this fix.

patch.description: Proposed unified diff patch. Labelled as PROPOSED — must NOT be automatically applied.

expected_effect.description: Description of the observable improvement after this fix is applied.

risks.description: List of risks or potential regressions introduced by this change.

validation_plan.description: Steps to validate that the fix resolves the root cause without regression.

rollback_plan.description: Safe rollback procedure if the fix causes a regression.

evidence_ids.description: Evidence IDs from the confirmed hypothesis that justify this fix.
